**Review: about page draft**

Claims check:

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted (Companies House) |
| "a small team of six" | Product fact (team size), fine as written |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted (Operations) |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unsupported.** Invented statistic |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | **Unsupported.** Not on the allowlist |

**Problems**

1. **"Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars"**: this figure isn't in the policy and contradicts what we can prove. The only approved rating claim is "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website". A 4.8 average can't be squared with 98% five-star ratings, and the draft also says "customers" rather than reviews. Replace it with the approved wording verbatim, or cut it.
2. **"we buy from gardens we've visited"**: the policy covers where a tea is grown and when it's picked, not a sourcing-practice claim like this one. It implies that all (or a meaningful share of) suppliers have been visited, and nobody has supplied proof of that. Either get written confirmation from the product team of exactly which gardens have been visited (and then name them or say "some"), or use `[PROOF NEEDED: which gardens the team has visited]`.

**Suggested rewrite (pending confirmation on the gardens line):**

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Our customers have rated us 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. [PROOF NEEDED: which tea gardens the team has visited]

The voice is fine (warm, plain, with no banned words). It needs Sam's sign-off before going live, since everything public goes through Sam.
